title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
summary: Hold: the briefing treats billing as unpublished and rates the cost as indirect only, although Microsoft's Work IQ API documentation specifies usage-based Copilot Credits billing. It also reports no control over the memory path without acknowledging the documented tenant policy layer that governs MCP resource-path requests.

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization with isEnabledInOrganization false updates the tenant enhanced-personalization control.
claims.quote:
PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization
isEnabledInOrganization | Boolean | If true, enables the enhanced personalization control

claims.claim: The enhanced-personalization API is a beta API.
claims.quote: APIs under the `/beta` version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change.

claims.claim: Updating enhanced personalization requires PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All.
claims.quote:
Delegated (work or school account) | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All | Not available.
Application | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All | Not available.

claims.claim: People Administrator is the required least-privileged role for delegated updates.
claims.quote: People Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization, rather than the new memory path, is on by default.
claims.quote: By default, Enhanced personalization is turned on.

claims.claim: Copilot personalization and memory are in preview and subject to change.
claims.quote: Copilot personalization and memory are in preview and subject to change.

claims.claim: Turning enhanced personalization off disables the saved-memory, chat-history and custom-instruction user controls.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off. They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: No admin-centre UI for the tenant enhanced-personalization setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "enhanced personalization" "admin center" memory control. Opened Manage Copilot personalization and memory, Enhanced personalization control overview and the Graph update reference; they document Graph configuration, not an admin-centre path.

claims.claim: A maker controls agent Memory in Copilot Studio through agent > Build > components panel > Memory toggle.
claims.quote:
1. Create or open the agent in Copilot Studio.
2. Select the Build tab.
3. In the components panel, use the Memory toggle to turn the feature on or off.

claims.claim: An API equivalent of the Microsoft Copilot harness agent Memory toggle is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Microsoft Copilot harness Memory toggle API Dataverse Web API memory setting; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform "memory" "Copilot" toggle. Read Memory overview and returned excerpts; no toggle API was documented.

claims.claim: The cited agent Memory feature concerns the Microsoft Copilot harness and is in preview.
claims.quote:
Memory (Microsoft Copilot) (preview)
This article describes Memory for agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: The maker turns Memory on or off for each Copilot Studio agent.
claims.quote: As the maker, you turn Memory on or off for each agent.

claims.claim: A user's memories from that agent are deleted after 28 days without interaction with the agent.
claims.quote: If a user doesn't interact with the agent for 28 days, the system deletes their memories from that agent.

claims.claim: Turning agent Memory off does not delete stored memories.
claims.quote: Turning Memory off doesn't delete stored memories. It only prevents the agent from using them.

claims.claim: Tenant Work IQ MCP policy can be turned on or off in Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools.
In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP.
On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.
Review the current policy state, then turn policy on or off for the tenant as needed.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for turning Work IQ MCP tenant policy on or off is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ MCP policy settings Microsoft Graph beta API configure policy; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph/api "Work IQ" "policy". Read policy governance and search excerpts; configuration is described, but no callable policy-update endpoint is specified.

claims.where: controls[3]; Governance controls table; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No tenant control over the memory profile path in Work IQ MCP is documented.
claims.quote:
It adds a request-time governance layer that can allow or deny specific MCP tool requests based on tenant policy.
When you turn on the policy, it applies across the tenant and helps control MCP tool access at request time.
claims.fix: Remove controls[3] and its rendered both-null row: the general Work IQ MCP request-policy layer is already represented by controls[2]. Replace 'with controls not yet published' in the risk rationale with 'with no memory-specific switch documented'. Do not imply that the absence of a dedicated memory setting exempts these MCP requests from tenant policy.

claims.claim: Purview retention policies do not apply to Copilot memory.

claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Saved memories are discoverable using eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer.
